outlook.statement: The Company proposes to submit an application to the Reserve Bank of India for grant of a Certificate of Registration (CoR) to commence business as a Non-Deposit Taking Non-Banking Financial Company – Type II. The Company intends to further strengthen and expand its insurance distribution business and plans to recruit qualified marketing professionals to expand operations across select districts.

The proposed registration is expected to support the Company's long-term strategy of diversifying its financial services business and creating sustainable value for its stakeholders. Pending receipt of the Certificate of Registration, the Company will continue to pursue its existing business activities while exploring new growth opportunities in compliance with the applicable regulatory framework.
The Company with its intention to start fresh NBFC business has again filed an application during the year with Reserve Bank of India (RBI).
The Holding Company with its intention to start fresh NBFC business has again filed an application during the year with Reserve Bank of India (RBI).
There is no impact of the newly enacted Labour Codes on the operations of the Group. The management does not foresee any future impact of the Labour Codes as well.
